notes.title: 🌌 A Neon Storm Is Coming... Are You Ready? 🌌
notes.content:
The Steam Autumn Sale arrives on November 27, and with it, the shadowy, pixel-perfect fury of Neon Ninja: Pixel Slasher! This is your call to embrace the night, slash through enemies, and claim an electrifying discount! ⚔️✨

⚡ Step into the glow:
- Wield your blade in a dazzling neon-lit world.
- Master the art of lightning-fast combat and deadly precision.
- Crush waves of foes while immersing yourself in retro-cyber vibes.

🕶️ Only the bold survive. With a deal this sharp, even your enemies will be jealous.

🎆 Mark November 27 — it’s your time to slice, dice, and shine! Don’t miss the sale, or the darkness might swallow you whole.
